title: Confirming Deactivate moves the ticked parts to the Inactive tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], signed in with the Admin role. Admin holds the 'Part Library & Inventory' permissions View, Create & Edit and Delete by default (Settings → Roles & Permissions); Delete is what allows Deactivate parts and Activate parts.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: at [Loc-1], 3 active, tracked parts [Part-A], [Part-B] and [Part-C] with part numbers starting ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKOFF- (examples), quantity 5 each.

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A] and pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. Create [Part-A]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL bulk off A" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKOFF-01 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-A] = the part number you typed.
  3. Create [Part-B]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL bulk off B" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKOFF-02 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-B] = the part number you typed.
  4. Create [Part-C]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL bulk off C" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKOFF-03 (examples), pick any Category (e.g. the first one offered), type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-C] = the part number you typed.
  5. Check the setup worked: the Active tab searched for ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKOFF lists [Part-A], [Part-B] and [Part-C] (3 rows).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu (Active tab).
  2. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKOFF in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar (to the left of New Inventory Part).
  4. Click Deactivate parts.
  5. Click the [Part-A] row.
  6. Click the [Part-B] row.
  7. Click the Deactivate button on the bar.
  8. Click Deactivate in the "Deactivate parts?" confirmation.
  9. Wait 10 seconds without touching the page.
  10. Click the Inactive tab.
  11. If the Search box is empty, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKOFF in it.
  12. Click the Active tab.
  13. If the Search box is empty, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BULKOFF in it.
  14. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  15. Click Deactivate parts.
  16. Click the [Part-C] row.
  17. Click the Deactivate button.
  18. Click Deactivate in the confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: The "Deactivate parts?" confirmation opens and reads "2 parts selected."
  • Step 8: A green toast reads "2 parts updated." [Part-A] and [Part-B] leave the Active list at once, without a page reload; [Part-C] is still listed. The dark bar and the checkbox column disappear: bulk mode has ended and nothing is ticked.
  • Step 9: The green toast closes on its own.
  • Step 11: The Inactive tab lists [Part-A] and [Part-B].
  • Step 17: The confirmation reads "1 part selected."
  • Step 18: A green toast reads "1 part updated."; [Part-C] leaves the Active list without a reload and bulk mode ends.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S2-R11, S2-R12, S2-R13, S2-R14, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.3 (Two rows ticked), board 4.4 (Confirm), board 4.5 (Done). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R11: “When the user confirms (Story 10), every ticked part becomes inactive.”
  • S2-R12: “The deactivated parts leave the Active tab without a page reload.”
  • S2-R13: “The deactivated parts appear on the Inactive tab.”
  • S2-R14: “When every ticked part changes, the mode ends and the selection clears.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, every part changed): “"{n} parts updated." ("1 part updated." for one)”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, every part changed): “Success toast, fades on its own”
